$comment: Policy for tuning this repository's automated quality thresholds.
Read and enforced by tests/tune-coverage.sh; see docs/quality.md.
This file is the rules. The thresholds themselves live in
.coverage-thresholds.json and are only ever changed by a reviewed commit.

directionRationale: A floor may be raised automatically because the evidence for raising it
is complete: the suite demonstrably reached that many lines. Lowering a
floor is the opposite -- the evidence is an absence, and the two causes
(a lost test, or a Bash version tracing the same code differently) are
indistinguishable from the count alone. Lowering therefore stays a human
decision with a stated reason, per CONTRIBUTING.md.
headroomRationale: Floors sit exactly at the observed minimum. Slack would let a real
regression hide inside it, and the floor is a ratchet, not a target.
observationRationale: Traced-line counts are Bash-version sensitive: identical code traces 117
lines of ostree-pkg-diff under 5.2.21 and 116 under 5.3.9. A floor
calibrated against one interpreter fails in the other for no real reason,
so a floor is the LOWEST count across every interpreter observed, never
the highest one CI happens to produce. Passing more interpreters with
--bash makes that rule mechanical instead of remembered.
supportedBashRationale: 5.2.21 is what ubuntu-24.04 runners ship, and 5.3.x is current on
developer machines. Both have to pass, which is what makes the
minimum-across-observations rule necessary rather than pedantic.
--apply is REFUSED unless every version listed here has been observed.
Without that gate the rule would still depend on the operator
remembering to pass --bash twice, and raising a floor to 117 from a 5.2
host alone would leave every 5.3 environment failing a gate that
nothing is actually wrong with. Reporting is not gated, because it

notAutomated: Nothing here commits, pushes, or opens a pull request. tests/tune-coverage.sh
is run by a person and its --apply mode edits one local file. A bot that
adjusted the quality gate on its own schedule would be automating exactly
the decision the gate exists to force.
